The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight
rate) at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.

(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee
statement.)

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight rate) at
its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.

The domestic economy seems likely to maintain its upward
trend.

While the expansion of investment has slowed down, exports
continue to post robust growth and private consumption shows a
steady increase.

The uncertainty surrounding future economic
developments, however, is increasing mainly due to the rises in
international oil prices and the prolonged international financial
market unrest.

While consumer price inflation remains broadly stable, upward
pressures are increasing somewhat mainly due to high oil prices.

The
upward trend of real estate prices has flattened out.

In the financial markets, there is ample liquidity and financial
institutions' lending continues to show a steady increase.
